original_benchmark.notes: Coding-agent setting (tasks/coding_agent/run_*_agent.sh @ 42c7780). Neither the scripts nor the paper pin CLI versions. Upstream also has single-shot and multi-turn LLM harnesses for the same 212 instances.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on a random 50-task subset (--split parity), 3 runs per side, Codex CLI 0.171.0 with gpt-5.4-mini. Executability, Uni3D and Chamfer run-score ranges overlap. SigLIP-2 ranges do not (original 0.1412 ± 0.0003, Harbor 0.1456 ± 0.0011); the README documents equivalent scoring on the same scripts and a per-task gap within sampling noise (p = 0.27). Oracle: 212/212. Reward = upstream executability; Chamfer distance, SigLIP-2 text-image and Uni3D 3D-3D similarity (the other Table 2 metrics, computed on CPU) in /logs/verifier/metrics.json. Re-scoring upstream's published GPT-5.4 mini Codex CLI scripts reproduces Table 2 (exec 1.000, SigLIP-2 0.155 vs 0.154, Uni3D 0.444 vs 0.450, CD 0.072 vs 0.072).
